title: Two-parameter classes of exactly solvable quantum systems
summary: We introduce two-parameter classes of exactly-solvable novel systems whose Hamiltonian operators could be represented by tridiagonal symmetric matrices in some orthogonal bases. The associated wavefunction is written as point-wise convergent series in the basis elements. The expansion coefficients of the series are orthogonal polynomials in the energy that satisfy the resulting three-term recursion relation starting with two-parameter initial values.
